exposure: Opioid use disorder (OUD) at delivery hospitalization
outcome: Incidence of opioid use disorder (OUD) at delivery hospitalization
Factors associated with OUD at delivery hospitalization
Maternal and obstetric outcomes (e.g., adverse perinatal outcomes)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 3,554,477 deliveries from the National Inpatient Sample between 2012 and 2016.
finding: The incidence of opioid use disorder (OUD) at delivery hospitalization significantly increased from 4.48 per 1000 deliveries in 2012 to 7.67 in 2016, with strong associations found for concurrent substance use, hepatitis C infection, white race, and public insurance.
